description: The LG.com app in ChatGPT helps you explore LG’s product lineup — including TVs, refrigerators, washers and dryers, monitors, laptops, and audio. Ask for recommendations based on your space, budget, or how you’ll use a product. Compare two models side by side, check specs and features, or ask straightforward questions about the technology behind a product. Answers are based on LG’s official product catalog, so you get the product details you need to narrow down a shortlist and choose with confidence.

defaultPrompt: Recommend LG TVs for my living room
